# Sample Project

**A digest maker for notes**

[![CI](https://example.com/badge.svg)](https://example.com/ci) [![License](https://example.com/l.svg)](LICENSE)

[Install](#install) · [Usage](#usage) · [FAQ](#faq)

Drop in a folder. *Sample Project* reads each note, finds [the themes](docs/themes.md) and
writes a `digest.md` with `__snake__case` kept & links reduced.

## Install
Run it.
